svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.13.2.1 Required Dampproofing
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.13 DAMPPROOFING, WATERPROOFING AND SOIL GAS CONTROL
Required Dampproofing

g.text: Exterior finished ground higher than the
ground level inside the foundation walls
Foundation walls and floors-on-ground, Sentences (1) and (2)
Floor in an unenclosed portion of a building
Floor over not less than 100 mm (3 15/16″) of
coarse clean granular material, not more
Floors that need not be dampproofed, Sentence (3)

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Except as in Article 9.13.3.1., where the
exterior finished ground level is higher than
the ground level inside the foundation walls,
exterior surfaces of foundation walls below
ground level are dampproofed
Except as in Sentence (3) and Article
9.13.3.1., floors-on-ground are dampproofed
That floor dampproofing need not be provided
for
(a) floors in garages, (b) floors in unenclosed
portions of buildings, or (c) floors installed
over not less than 100 mm (3 15/16″) of coarse
clean granular material containing not more than
10% of material that will pass a 4 mm sieve.
Drawn: A cut through a basement wall. Article 9.13.3.1. covers waterproofing instead. Sizes are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.13.2.1. (page 9-109)
